app.name: TypeCSF
app.tagline: Learn Computer Science while you learn to type.
app.docTitle: TypeCSF - Learn Computer Science while you type
app.docDescription: TypeCSF is a free typing trainer that teaches Computer Science fundamentals. 30 lessons, a 24-page handbook, practice, games and quizzes in English, Dari and Pashto. Works offline.

hero.eyebrow: Free typing and Computer Science trainer
hero.title: Learn Computer Science while you learn to type
hero.subtitle: TypeCSF joins touch-typing practice with 30 Computer Science lessons and a 24-page handbook. Every minute of practice teaches you something real, in English, Dari or Pashto.

features.title: Everything you need to practise
features.subtitle: One calm place to build typing speed, accuracy and Computer Science knowledge.

lessons.title: 30 typing lessons
lessons.text: Five levels from computer basics to emerging technologies. Each lesson explains an idea, then you type it.

handbook.title: A 24-page handbook
handbook.text: Finish every lesson to unlock eight parts of real Computer Science explanations to type and study.

keyboard.title: Guided on-screen keyboard
keyboard.text: See the next key, the right finger and the Shift key. It follows your real keyboard as you type.

practice.title: Practice modes
practice.text: Home row, letters, words, sentences, symbols, code, timed tests and your own text.

games.title: Games and quizzes
games.text: Short challenges and 30 quiz questions make practice more fun without pressure.

progress.title: Honest progress
progress.text: Speed, accuracy and trends from your own practice. No made-up numbers.

s1.title: Pick a lesson
s1.text: Start with level 1 or search for any topic.

s2.title: Read, then type
s2.text: Read the key ideas beside the typing area, then type the English text shown.

s3.title: Watch yourself improve
s3.text: Your speed and accuracy are saved on this device and shown on the Dashboard.

progress.title: Your progress, honestly measured
progress.text: TypeCSF measures what really happened in each run and shows nothing it cannot calculate.
progress.b1: Net WPM counts only correct characters.
progress.b2: Accuracy counts every key press, so a corrected mistake still shows.
progress.b3: Consistency shows how steady your speed was.
progress.b4: Everything stays in your browser. Nothing is sent anywhere.

cs.title: Typing and Computer Science, together
cs.text: Typing is the first skill of every programmer. TypeCSF lets you build it while you learn what a computer, an algorithm, a network or a database really is.
cs.topics: Computer basics · Data and algorithms · Programming · Systems, networks and security · Emerging technologies

measure.title: How TypeCSF measures your typing
measure.wpm: Net WPM = (correct characters / 5) / minutes. One word counts as 5 characters.
measure.cpm: CPM (characters per minute) = correct characters / minutes.
measure.acc: Accuracy = (keystrokes - wrong keystrokes) / keystrokes. A wrong key stays counted even if you fix it with Backspace, so accuracy reflects your first attempt. Fixing it still helps your net WPM.
measure.cons: Consistency shows how steady your speed was during the run.
measure.done: A lesson is complete when you finish it with at least your chosen accuracy (Settings, default 90%).
measure.privacy: Privacy: everything is saved only in this browser. Nothing is sent anywhere. The only exception is a suggestion you choose to send with the form.
